Breakfast. Free day in Cusco.

**Sacred Valley of the Incas**

You can book an optional excursion to the Sacred Valley of the Incas for $225.

The excursion includes a buffet lunch featuring Peruvian dishes.
View from above of a historic church and tiled rooftops around a square in Cusco, Peru
Cusco, Peru, from above, with a historic church and tiled rooftops around a square

After breakfast, you transfer to the bus station and take a tourist coach to Puno. The route crosses the highlands and includes several stops.

The first stop is the village of Andahuaylillas and its church, San Pedro de Andahuaylillas. Its richly painted walls have earned it the name ‘Sistine Chapel of South America’. The church was built in 1631 on the foundations of an ancient Inca temple. Its exterior is fairly modest, while the interior is decorated with paintings and ornamental plasterwork.

The next stop is Raqchi, an archaeological complex at about 3,500 m above sea level. It was home to a religious centre and the Temple of Viracocha. The temple measures about 92 m by 25 m, and its roof was supported by 22 columns.

You stop for a buffet lunch in Sicuani, then at La Raya Pass at about 4,400 m, before visiting Pucará and its local museum.

You reach Puno at around 18:00. The city sits at about 3,860 m on Lake Titicaca, one of the world’s best-known navigable high-altitude lakes. You check in at your hotel and can spend the evening resting after the long journey through the highlands.
